verdict: Counts and107completion bindings independently reproduced. Weak measured projection dependence is established; its cause remains unidentified. No promotion or future-fit approval.

responses.finding: The existing executor already scores tiles with learned query-candidate interactions; weak dependence is not proof of an injection bottleneck.
responses.action: Accepted. Supersedes the stronger 'demonstrated weak injection path' wording in frozen Q01-REPORT.md and the old research-log entry. The finding is weak measured dependence through this trained projection. No new scorer architecture is justified yet. The next comparison reuses the existing readout.

responses.finding: Independently trainable upstream forecasters/filtering confound a dynamic-versus-mean geometry comparison.
responses.action: Accepted. Freeze a prospectively named L02 upstream checkpoint, its representations, forecasts, priors and baseline causal filtering for both arms. Train only identical copies of the existing execution readout and conditioning projection. This is a readout probe, not independently retrained persistent-policy evidence.
